paragraphs: Mentioned in Tanchuma, Toldot 22, where he reported in the name of R' Acha.[^1][^2]

notes.text: תלדות-כב gives Toldot 22. Earlier machine OCR had תלדותחכב; no standard/Buber edition is specified or independently checked.
Natan is the reporting subject in Hyman’s formula and reports Acha. HaChaver preserves החבר; no Rav/Rabbi is added to the heading. Acha’s abbreviated title remains R'.
